source_text: Background: The role of carbon-shell encapsulation in cycle life in silicon anodes is debated. Methods: We treated silicon anodes with carbon-shell encapsulation and measured cycle life across 20 independent replicates. Results: Carbon-shell encapsulation decreased cycle life relative to vehicle controls (p = 0.04). Secondary endpoints were unchanged. Conclusions: In this model, carbon-shell encapsulation decreased cycle life.
